title: Noctiluca
description: A house made of moving light. The page is a 3D corridor you walk through: scroll moves the camera room by room, and every wall is a live shader gradient.
stack: Next.js 16 · Tailwind v4 · React 19 · WebGL2 · CSS 3D

sections.title: I · Blue Hour
sections.summary: "The twenty minutes after the sun." Label: Civil twilight, sun 0° to −6°, ≈ 460 nm, Lisbon June 21:05–21:38.

sections.title: II · Aurora
sections.summary: "Curtains that answer the solar wind." Label: green line 557.7 nm, red line 630.0 nm, trace Tromsø 10 May 2024.

sections.title: III · Noctiluca
sections.summary: "The sea, lit from inside." The only room that reacts to the pointer. Label: Noctiluca scintillans, ≈ 474 nm, 0.1 s flashes.

sections.title: IV · Alpenglow
sections.summary: "The mountain keeps the sun after you lose it." Label: ≈ 610 nm, ≈ 400 km of atmosphere.

sections.title: Exit
sections.summary: logo with tagline, "The light keeps moving after you leave.", footer nav, address, ©.
